choices.content: The middle 50% of the data are more spread out.

question.prompt: A larger interquartile range indicates that ( ).

solutions.explanation: The interquartile range is the difference between the third quartile and the first quartile. It reflects the range of the middle 50% of the data. A larger interquartile range indicates greater spread.
solutions.title: Interpret the interquartile range
